servers.name: personal
servers.guidance: User mail, calendar, commitments, and indexed notes. mindos_search for inbox/notes; mindos_calendar_* for schedule; mindos_summarize_url for any summarize-this-link/PDF request (one tool call, one final answer); mindos_gmail_sync → mindos_process_outbox when search is empty.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.guidance: mindos_fs_locate once for natural find/count/list (folder + name from user words). mindos_fs_find only for explicit globs. No root=/. Destructive: preview then confirmed=True.

servers.name: convert
servers.guidance: Local conversion; source unchanged. mindos_fs_locate or mindos_convert_file (paths from user words). Batch: mindos_convert_batch previews then confirmed=True.

servers.name: fetch
servers.guidance: Backend for mindos_summarize_url (PDF/HTML pagination). Do not call fetch_* directly for user summarize requests—use mindos_summarize_url instead. search_web only for open-web queries without a URL.

servers.name: gdrive
servers.guidance: Gmail attachment binary store (drive_create_file / drive_read_file). Auth once: npx @ibarcarty/mcp-server-google-drive auth
